descriptions.w3d_s20_release_pair_800e77dc: Appears to release two held objects with a deleting call and clear both fields.
descriptions.w3d_s20_apply_handle_pair_8013a048: Appears to resolve a stored handle, clear it when stale, and otherwise submit two values from the object to a helper.
descriptions.w3d_s20_state_in_set_8013d88c: Appears to test whether the state value at offset 684 belongs to a fixed set of values and returns 1 or 0.
